articles.summary: Union Pacific special agents recently joined local, county and federal law enforcement agencies to participate in the Law Enforcement Torch Run for Special Olympics in Nebraska and Kansas.
articles.title: Union Pacific Police Pass the Torch

articles.summary: “We constantly work to review and improve our safety practices and often exceed federal safety regulations. We recently worked with our industry and the Department of Transportation to implement eight new voluntary safety practices, all of which were effective earlier this week."
articles.title: U.S. Energy Renaissance Depends on Safe Rail Transportation

articles.summary: Marquise Knox's "Feel Like Goin' Home" serves as soundtrack for an insider's view of Union Pacific Dupo Terminal operations in the third in a series of four "Listen UP" videos slated to be filmed this year.
articles.title: Blues Man Rocks UP's Dupo Terminal

articles.summary: Aurora and Denver, Colorado, made a clean sweep of barriers and built a bridge between their communities with the Peoria Street Overpass.
articles.title: New Overpass Helps Bridge Communities

articles.summary: A donation to the city of Roseville, California, rotary snowplow SPMW 7221 takes up residence outside J.R. Davis Yard, at the entrance to downtown.
articles.title: Historic Rotary Snowplow Receives Warm Welcome in Roseville

articles.summary: "Whether you’re on foot or in your car, this campaign reminds the pedestrians and motorists to keep themselves safe by following railroad safety laws and only crossing at designated grade crossings."
articles.title: Safety Campaign’s Message: Always Expect a Train

articles.summary: A Railcar Inspection Portal (RIP), which instantly provides a 360-degree view of railcars passing through U.S.-Mexico crossings, recently detected 15 bundles of marijuana near Nogales, Arizona.
articles.title: UP Technology Impacting Cross-Border Security

articles.summary: UP Field Management Trainees, "dedicated to serve," recently volunteered at Omaha's Open Door Mission.
articles.title: UP Trainees on a 'Mission' to Lend a Hand
